correctness.rationale: The third iterate depends on exactly four columns, yielding a bijection between F^3-fixed n-column configurations and closed n-walks in a fully enumerated 4096-vertex, 10824-edge finite directed graph. Exact Kosaraju SCC decomposition gives cyclic sizes 136,8,3,3,1,1, with all but two simple directed triangles locally F-fixed. Each exceptional triangle contributes 3 labelled initial phases iff n is divisible by 3. Two independent Python scripts were replayed: exact full finite graph proof certificate and direct exhaustive simulation for n=3..5. The proof is all-n; finite initial-state enumeration is corroborative only.

value.rationale: This is a complete, natural periodic-orbit sector classification for the standard Toom majority rule on an entire four-row cylinder family, revealing a sharp modulus-three obstruction and only two temporal period-three orbits, in direct qualitative contrast with richer height-three dynamics. The finite width and primitive temporal-three observable are motivated by understanding the first change in periodic-orbit structure beyond earlier three-row studies, not by arbitrary parameter picking. It also gives a reproducible, reusable short-return graph representation; no broad theory for all heights is claimed.
